analyst.summary: PC Jeweller, a gold and diamond jewellery retailer, has sharply deleveraged its balance sheet over the past two years (bank debt down more than 70%, targeting debt-free status this quarter) while profit has grown strongly, and the promoter recently injected fresh capital via warrant conversion. The company carries a history of financial stress from earlier this decade, and a large further equity issuance (QIP) is being sought. We rate it a Hold: a credible turnaround in progress, but one still working through a legacy of past distress and near-term dilution.
